history.value: A generated or custom enemy power whose only hook is RoundEnd gives the net no input row: py/src/features.rs writes RoundEnd hooks only as the opt-in countdown kind, and every net's row_kinds are triggered, threshold, held (is_hook_power ignores RoundEnd too). So training on nine RoundEnd mechanics (the wide pack) cut nothing: RoundEnd-Damage +2.26/+2.30 HP beyond parent on the 18-mechanic and wide s1 nets, +2.48 on pns1, where trained turn-start/turn-end damage reads -0.2 to +0.3 and untrained +2.8. Official content uses RoundEnd only for ReduceSelf countdowns (Vulnerable, Weak, Frail, Intangible). Exit: candidate 71 (roundend-rows), 65's step 0.
